description: This file defines the WatchConnectivityReceiver class, which manages communication between an iOS app and the Apple Watch using WCSession. It handles session activation, sending messages (including reply drafts), and processing incoming messages and notifications related to watch connectivity.

classes.name: WatchConnectivityReceiver
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle and message handling of a WCSession between iOS and Apple Watch, including sending replies and processing received messages.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the WCSession and sets the delegate.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures the WCSession is activated, with retries.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply to the watch using message or user info transfer.
